slot_scores.name: project1_investment_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: For project (1), is the 20% annual profit paid at the end of each year while the principal remains invested, and can you invest in or withdraw from project (1) at the beginning of any of the three years?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether project (1) can be invested at the beginning of any of the three years.

slot_scores.name: project1_reinvestment_rule
slot_scores.evidence_quote: When you invest in project (1) at the beginning of a year, is the 20% profit paid only for that one year (i.e., the investment is a one-year instrument you can reinvest each year), or does the principal stay in project (1) and keep earning 20% every year until you choose to withdraw it?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about reinvestment of project (1) principal and profit in subsequent years.

slot_scores.name: project2_recovery_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: For project (2), is the 150% total return paid as a single lump sum at the end of the third year (i.e., you get back 1.5 times the amount invested, with nothing before then)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about project (2) recovery timing; after correction, turn 3 confirmed end of second year.

slot_scores.name: project3_investment_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: For project (3), can you invest in it at the beginning of any of the three years, or only at the beginning of the first year?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether project (3) investment timing is restricted.

slot_scores.name: project4_investment_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: For project (4), can you invest in it at the beginning of any of the three years, or only at a specific year?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether project (4) investment timing is restricted.
